resolution.note: Two mock-provider scenarios capture the real codex 0.167.0 usage-limit and failed-compaction frames; usage-limit.json replaces the synthetic frame. Without an account, account/rateLimits/read is refused (-32600), so reset_at stays absent: the reply's reset reaches the client only through account/rateLimits/updated, which carries account keys and stays opted out.

title: Capture the usage-limit and failed-compaction receiver frames from the mock Responses provider
body:
Outcome: worker-failure-class and compaction-turn tests read frames the real codex app-server wrote, produced by scripts/codex/mock-responses.ts serving a 429 usage-limit reply and a failed compaction, instead of hand-written frames.
Evidence: test/worker/mock-provider.test.ts (t-m1jmgcv) drives codex 0.167.0 through krn worker against the mock in about 5 s with no account; startMockProvider already accepts `{ status, body, headers }` replies.
Acceptance: two scenarios run against the mock in CI (the shard that installs codex), assert the worker failure class `usageLimitExceeded` (retryable, reset_at from the reply) and the compaction failure outcome, and no frame matches `accountKey` from scripts/codex/app-server-replay.ts.
